messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired for service=embedding-queue-prod (high error rate). alert_id=PD-4721. Threshold: 5xx > 5% for 3m. Links: https://pagerduty.example/PD-4721 and runbook: https://go/runbooks/embedding-queue

pagerbot: Auto-ack attempted, no human ack within 2m, escalating to second on-call tier.

Alex Chen: Acked. Looking. I’m on-call (infra). Starting with quick health checks.

Priya Singh: Noted. I can help with tracing / logs. Tagging Mateo for embedding infra context.

Alex Chen: Running quick checks: `kubectl get pods -n inference -l app=embedder -o wide` -> many pods in Running but 3 pods in CrashLoopBackOff. Pulling logs: 
```
kubectl logs embedder-7f4d -n inference | tail -n 120
ERR: oom killer invoked, java.lang.OutOfMemoryError at com.redwood.embed
HTTP/1.1 502  upsteam response failed
```

Mateo Rivera: Hmm, we've been seeing memory pressure since the v2.1 model rollout yesterday. Memory profiles spiked for longer seqs. Could be KV cache growth + large prompt batching.

Alex Chen: Temporarily scaling up replica count for embedder deployment to relieve queue. `kubectl scale deploy/embedder --replicas=10 -n inference` -> done. Also bumping nodepool autoscaler to allow more nodes.

Lina Park: I'm pulling autoscaler metrics. If nodes not provisioning fast enough, we should fallback to the small-model variant (v2.0) to reduce memory per request. Runbook step 4 covers controlled fallback.

Priya Singh: Can we toggle routing to dedicated pool (dedicated-eu-1) for enterprise tenants to reduce customer impact? That would buy us time while we stabilize.

Alex Chen: Routed about 30% traffic to dedicated-eu-1 via routing rule. Command: `redwoodctl routes set --service embedding-queue-prod --weight dedicated-eu-1=30%` -> applied.

incident-bot: PD escalation: auto-escalated to SRE lead after 7 minutes (policy).

Lina Park: Taking ownership from here. Assigning to SRE: Lina Park (primary). Alex, maintain scaling + pod restarts. Mateo/Priya please continue diagnostics.

Alex Chen: Continuing. Forced restart of the 3 CrashLoopBackOff pods, cleared local disk cache, limited batch size via config override: `EMBED_BATCH_MAX=64` pushed.

Mateo Rivera: Observed large KV cache spikes for certain prompt patterns. Temporarily enabling KV eviction policy: `kv_cache.eviction=lru` and threshold 70%. Pushed config to 2 nodes for validation.

CS Team: Heads-up from Support — some enterprise customers reported increased 502s since ~09:14 UTC. No data corruption reported, some timeouts. We’ll prepare a status blurb if impact persists.

Priya Singh: Tracing shows that <customer-A> requests with very long context are causing sustained memory growth. We can add a hard token limit at the load balancer as stop-gap. Proposing `X-Redwood-Max-Tokens=8192` and returning 413 if exceeded.

Lina Park: Agreed. Alex, please apply a rate/size limit at the edge for now. Also start a canary rollback to model v2.0 for 20% traffic.

Alex Chen: Applied token limit at edge LB. Started canary rollback: `redwoodctl rollout model embedding-queue-prod --variant v2.0 --traffic 20%` -> in progress.

pagerbot: PagerDuty note: PD-4721 acknowledged by Alex Chen and transferred to Lina Park (SRE lead).

incident-bot: Automated mitigation triggered: routing fallback to v2.0 at 20% and replica scale to 10. Monitor for 10m window.

Mateo Rivera: After the rollback and KV eviction, error rate dropped from 8.9% -> 2.1% over 6 minutes. Latency p95 also improving.

Priya Singh: Confirming logs show no new OOMs on restarted pods. CPU/mem graphs look healthier.

CS Team: Drafting customer-facing message. Will hold until we confirm stabilization for 15 minutes.

Lina Park: OK team — keep watch. We'll keep PD page open. If error rate <1% and no OOMs for 15m, we'll mark mitigated. Assigning follow-ups: postmortem owner = Mateo Rivera, mitigation steps documented by Alex Chen.

Alex Chen: Noted; collecting command history and logs for the postmortem.

pagerbot: PD-4721 updated: incident state -> under investigation (SRE lead: Lina Park).

20 minutes later...

Mateo Rivera: p99 and error rate stable: error rate 0.6%, p95 latency back to baseline. No new crashes.

Priya Singh: Edge token limiter returned ~140 requests with >8192 tokens; those were throttled 413 and logged. Good to have as a short-term control.

CS Team: Sending initial note to affected customers (enterprise cohort) with ETA for full recovery and FYI.

Lina Park: Mitigation succeeded. Preparing to close PD. Next steps: roll forward rollback plan if needed, schedule postmortem for 48 hours, add automated guardrails to detect KV growth patterns earlier.

Alex Chen: Closing PD once cleanup complete. I'll scale replicas back to baseline (5) in 10m pending continued stability.

pagerbot: PD-4721: resolved by Lina Park. Resolution summary: memory pressure from v2.1 rollout caused OOMs; mitigated by limiting batch size, enabling KV eviction, routing 20% to v2.0, scaling replicas and nodepool. Postmortem assigned to Mateo Rivera.

Lina Park: Thanks everyone. Please add any follow-up action items to the postmortem doc: https://go/postmortems/PD-4721

Alex Chen: :thumbsup: Great teamwork. Closing thread.
